<thought>To find the required template, I will search the retrosynthetic template catalog for a reaction that forms a C=C double bond while breaking a C–O and a C–C bond, matching the Doebner modification. I will use the likely product SMILES “Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=CC(=O)O)cc2)cc1” as the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=CC(=O)O)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["C-O", "C-C"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C=C"],
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
